name: ListComponents

parameters.help_en: The IDs of Dataset Accelerator components. Separate multiple component IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速组件ID的列表，多个组件ID以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: component_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the Dataset Accelerator component. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速组件名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The version of the Dataset Accelerator component
parameters.name: version

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
- Desc: descending order.
- Asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排列顺序，取值如下：
- Desc： 降序排列。
- Asc： 升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number of the component list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 组件列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of components to display per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的组件数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size
